scenes.headline: How Matryoshka Attribution ranks a network's parts
scenes.sub: One training run, a circuit at every size.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kipper! Which parts of a network produce a behaviour? Matryoshka Attribution learns the answer by gradient descent.

scenes.text: Learn one score per part: each step, keep a soft top-k at a random budget and patch the rest, so one run ranks every circuit size.
scenes.mark: one run ranks every circuit size
scenes.say: The idea: learn one score per part. Each step, keep a soft top k at a random budget and patch the rest. One run ranks every circuit size.

steps.say: Start with one score per part, all zero. The model stays frozen.
Each step draws a new budget k. A sigmoid top k turns the scores into a soft mask that sums to k.
Kept parts run on the real input. The rest are patched with values from a counterfactual input.
The loss asks the kept parts to preserve the behaviour, a logit difference.
The gradient flows back into the scores. Repeat a few hundred times.

steps.label: Each budget adds the next part
steps.say: Raising k only ever raises each part's weight, so each bigger budget adds the next part.

steps.label: Every mask sits inside the next
steps.say: The mask at budget three sits inside the mask at budget four, like nested dolls. The sorted scores are a circuit at every size.

left.title: Patch one at a time
items: Backups that cover for each other look useless
left.say: Patching one part at a time misses backups. Each looks useless alone.

right.title: Train nested masks
items: Whole sets patched while it trains
Learns that one backup is enough
right.say: Training patches whole sets, so it learns that one backup is enough.

scenes.title: Benchmark score, edge level
scenes.note: CPR rewards beating the full model; on CMD it ranks eighth of eleven
scenes.say: On the benchmark's main score it averages five point six, against one point nine five. That score rewards beating the full model. On the other, it's eighth of eleven.

scenes.text: One run ranks every circuit size. Whether that circuit drives the behaviour or reproduces the model is the loss's choice.
scenes.say: One run ranks every circuit size. Whether the circuit drives the behaviour or reproduces the model is the loss's choice.

recap: A fresh budget k every step
Nested masks give every circuit size
scenes.say: Scores, a random budget, and nested masks. That's Matryoshka Attribution.
